caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a bald eagle with outstretched wings, rendered in shades of brown, tan, and golden yellow. The eagle's head is white with a yellow beak and open mouth. It is perched atop a shield that features the United States flag design: the top section is blue with white stars, and the lower part has vertical red and white stripes. The eagle and shield are resting on a horizontal branch or piece of foliage, colored in variations of brown and gold. The background is plain, off-white with no other elements, and there is a signature "L.B. HARTMANN" at the bottom right of the image.
title: Ship's Stern Ornament
